historical_aggregate.methodology: Fixed-weight bounded scores. Missing dimensions retain weight and contribute [0,100]; no redistribution. Heuristic scores are not calibrated probabilities.

assumptions: Reported OCF assumed after cash interest and tax; scheduled operating flows exclude debt service
Variable costs scale with revenue; remaining costs fixed; both receive the cost shock
Tax shields/charges on incremental EBIT and interest realized within the year at supplied tax_rate
Floating principal reprices immediately until its dated repayment; Actual/365 interest, no compounding
Cash haircut transfers opening cash into noncurrent restricted cash; it is not an equity loss
NI minus OCF changes other noncash current assets; inventory and nondebt liabilities held fixed
Capex capitalized; dividends reduce equity; no automatic borrowing, refinancing or asset sales
Interest on principal after the horizon is paid at horizon; same-day flows netted; no intraday model

portfolio_impact.method: One-time weighted constituent price shocks at supplied weights; no future covariance or volatility estimate

method: Matched one-year baseline/adverse cash-flow and accounting bridges; principal repaid on supplied dates, fixed/floating rate exposure, collection delays, restricted cash and no balancing plugs.
limitations: All scenario results are hypothetical, not forecasts
Conditional overall scores update credit, financial and liquidity rules only; historical market/operational scores are held fixed
Income tax effects, cash conversion, cost behavior and restricted cash classification are explicit scenario assumptions, not verified projections
No automatic emergency borrowing or refinancing; funding gaps withhold projected scores
Spot market shocks change portfolio value; historical covariance and VaR are not reestimated from invented future observations
